Stock expectation restricted to exercise states
Call components and writer hedge interpretation

scope: Full official English caption text read sequentially; no comprehensive audiovisual audit; all numerical examples independently recomputed.
source_corrections: Risk-neutral measure is not actual investor preferences.
Diffusion volatility and quadratic variation are preserved, while finite-horizon stock variances generally change.
The conditional stock mean divides the truncated exercise-state expectation by its event probability.
Holdings identities require separate self-financing gains conditions.
Large-stock call boundary retains the discounted-strike offset.
Dividend lower bound gives a sufficient condition against exercise, not an unconditional converse.
Novikov is stated as a sufficient martingale condition; constant-coefficient likelihood is verified directly.
primary_checks: Lalley lecture10, pages1-3 Theorems1-2: stochastic exponential, Novikov, Girsanov signs; pages4-6 equivalence and quadratic variation.
Kogan MIT stochastic slides17-20: self-financing portfolio, replication, PDE and call formula.
